title: VPC Endpoints: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Your server needs to reach S three. Does that traffic really have to go over the internet? No, a V P C endpoint keeps it private.

scenes.heading: The private mailroom
scenes.narration: There are two kinds of endpoint. Gateway endpoints are free, and only work for S three and Dynamo D B. They work through your route table. Interface endpoints use PrivateLink, and cover most other services. They cost an hourly fee, plus data charges.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Only S three and Dynamo D B. They have an hourly cost. Only gateway endpoints use route tables.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva VPC endpoints lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Gateway endpoints: free, S three and Dynamo D B. Interface endpoints use PrivateLink. Both keep traffic off the internet. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva VPC endpoints lab.
